knownLimits: 360p does not support proving every key press or server damage timestamp.
Action conditions and phase order take precedence over approximate seconds.
Aetherflow checks and recurring DoT expiry checks are tool supplements, not observed casts.
Static playback cannot detect HP, cooldown, targetability, gauge, movement, or party mitigation.
